'''June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (8 June)''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG constructed tournament held on Sunday 8 June 2003 at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, in MNSWCCG's "Road to States" series before the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-1291-28951">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28951#28951 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Thirteen players came, and [[Nick Kolnik]] played to avoid a bye, making 14. Kolnik won as the only undefeated player.<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" />

The event came the day after the [[2003 Wisconsin State Championship]] in Madison, to which 16 Minnesota players had travelled. The Maple Grove group of players attended for the first time in some while, and the Rosemount group was also represented.<ref name="pcf-1291-28951" />
